kill_criteria: MV-75 Above Threshold Reprogramming not approved and obligated by 31 Dec 2026, or the cumulative catch-up charge recognised exceeds $120m (10-Q Note 12 maximum) in any quarter.
FY2026 Manufacturing cash flow before pension contributions reported below $600m or FY2026 adjusted EPS guide cut below $6.20.
Textron Aviation jet deliveries below 40 per quarter for two consecutive quarters (Q2 FY26: 40) or Aviation segment margin below 10%.
Manufacturing-group net debt/capital above 30% (10-Q liquidity table; 20% at 4 Jul 2026) or an Industrial separation announced on terms that leave Textron with stranded debt above $3.5bn.
Adjusted-to-GAAP EPS gap above $1.20 in FY2027 guidance.

Net adverse prior-year development in any quarter exceeding $250m (Q2 2026: $145m favourable).
Core operating ROE below 9.0% for two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: 11.1%).
Total debt/total capital above 22% (Q2 2026: 18.1%) or AIG Parent liquidity below $5bn (Q2 2026: $7.4bn).
Constant-dollar General Insurance NPW growth below 3% for two quarters (Q2 2026: +9%).

kill_criteria: Organic revenue growth below 2% for two consecutive quarters (Q2 CY26: +3.8%).
Adjusted operating margin below 9.3% for the calendar year or guidance cut below the current "9.5% - 9.8%".
Net debt/adjusted EBITDA above 2.25x (company-stated 1.3x at 30 Jun 2026; consolidated, per release) after FloWorks closes.
Full-year 2026 operating cash flow below $1.6bn (CY25: $2.2bn; H1 CY26: $716m).
Gross margin below 30.0% in any quarter (Q2 CY26: 31.0%).
